SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
OTHER_TERMINATION: conservative_contact_stop or other non-goal termination without confirmed geometric collision/corridor intrusion; preserve original termination reason
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
margin_duration_note: Inspection-interval duration, not exact threshold-crossing time; overlapping obstacle violations counted once
label: PHASE3_STAGE2_SELECTED_S0
technical_failure_policy: Pilots: halt on technical failure, no retry. Remaining batch: record technical failure, continue only unattempted fixed jobs. Never resume an interrupted remaining invocation.
scope_label: N=4 selected exploratory; oracle static geometry; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim
STUCK: simulation_timeout at 90s with no collision/corridor breach/goal
pilot_order: D750 index1 CURV-SPEED,HORIZON-SPEED,GRAPH; counted in main
remaining_order: D750 index2..4 in method order, then D0 GRAPH index1..3

horizon_speed.remaining: literal PP nearest projection arclength to endpoint
horizon_speed.elapsed: simulation time since actual FRESH switch; not arrival

speed.formula: curvature target clip(.4/abs(kappa),.05,.2), rate-limit v, clip(v*kappa,+/-.4)

graph.implementation: unchanged nomad_phase2.graph_worker imports unchanged Graph v4; same solver weights/certificate
graph.B: actual FRESH switch pose; immutable even if CPU job queues
graph.prior: last accepted corrected path, retained across subsequent RAW switches
graph.raw: immediately at original first eligible tick; variable speed
graph.queue: one CPU process, FIFO every switched FRESH; capacity512 exceeds <=361 captures per90s; no execution wait; terminal outstanding logged, never applied
graph.stale_clock: worker_end-start includes setup+solve+certificate; solver time separately logged; IPC/queue separately logged
graph.superseded: newer controller-side FRESH received by application tick, including simultaneous switch
graph.accept: same latest valid FRESH, not stale, success AND constraints AND exact certificate; next9Hz tick
graph.timeout: original receive-based 1s never reset by Graph
graph.zero_previous_v: unchanged Graph initialization rejection, no invented curvature

candidate_rule.goal_time: GRAPH success median <=1.2 times fastest median of speed methods with >=1 success; unavailable if neither succeeds
candidate_rule.D0: GRAPH successes index1..3 >= stored RAW same indices

metric_notes.curvature_saturation: abs(kappa)>8 for variable speed; additionally record original PP fixed-speed clipping diagnostics
metric_notes.graph_application_ratio: applied corrected path control ticks / valid path control ticks; also accepted corrected FRESH / switched FRESH
metric_notes.margin: independent of SUCCESS; interval lower-bound 2cm criterion
metric_notes.graph_dispositions: one primary precedence SUPERSEDED,STALE,EXPIRED,INIT_REJECTED,NONCONVERGED,CONSTRAINT_FAILED,ACCEPTED; independent flags retained
